versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 adds Markdown prose unwrapping.

- Joins hard-wrapped prose into one line per paragraph while preserving documented Markdown structures and hard line breaks.
- Supports dry-run previews, folder checks, and explicit-path writes.
- Preserves CRLF line endings and avoids adding spaces between joined CJK characters.
- Reports limitations and recommends reviewing changes before and after writing.
